discription: A basic pulse wave with a low-pass filter whose cutoff frequency is modulated by an LFO.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5, cutoff=8000, rq=0.5, lfoRate=2, lfoDepth=0.2; var sig, env, filterMod, modulatedCutoff, filteredSig; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pulseWidth); filterMod = SinOsc.kr(lfoRate) * (cutoff * lfoDepth); modulatedCutoff = (cutoff + filterMod).clip(20, 20000); filteredSig = RLPF.ar(sig, modulatedCutoff, rq); Out.ar(out, (filteredSig * amp * env) ! 2); }
